findings.finding: The patch owns one mantle mirror sprite inside the existing reading-hand SKCropNode, synchronizes only when the R097 node has the exact appearance and reading-pose metadata, and clears/hides the mirror when that selection/route is absent. It does not alter the source body, book, palm nodes, Core, saves, assets, or equipment rules.

The rebuild path resets the mirror reference alongside readingHands before removeAllChildren(), so a prior scene mirror is not retained. Initial attach creates the mirror then performs a sync; subsequent ActorBodyFrame.record invokes the callback registered in bindEquipmentFrame, and Root R002 correctly removes the redundant explicit post-record sync from that callback.

limitations: This source change only mirrors the existing mantle layer through the two palm masks; it does not establish visibility of the full seated torso mantle.
Visual acceptance of selected/reset comparisons and book/hand readability remains pending; this source review is not build or runtime approval.
